study: Existing RSI Gold Scalper, unchanged default rules; offline causal M1 execution research

source.timestamp_semantics: Printed broker wall-clock fields. Epoch seconds are arithmetic coordinates only; broker UTC offset not established.
source.point_size_note: Printed decimal precision is not independently verified SYMBOL_POINT or tick size. SPREAD is in broker points.
source.gap_note: Intervals include scheduled broker closures as well as possible missing data. Session metadata is absent; gaps are not assumed tradable.

clocks.timestamp_assumption: Assume CSV printed broker wall time is UTC+3 throughout; offset is not independently verified.
Assume CSV printed broker wall time is UTC+0 throughout; offset is not independently verified.

cautions: UTC+3 primary and UTC sensitivity are assumptions, never chosen by returns.
Broker point0.01, minute minimum spread, slippage0.10 per fill and commission0.07 per ounce are assumptions.
Primary fixed TP1 matches entry-only email use; TP2 is an alternative full-position exit, with no invented partial split.
Managed exits evaluate existing position-aware CLOSE logic; the current email scheduler does not provide this position context.
One-position execution is a declared model; recipient positions and API availability are not reconstructed.
The final30% has been inspected before and is not untouched out-of-sample data.
No swaps, account sizing, volume rounding, margin, historical news, latency or exact historical ask ticks.
